# Insurance ING Broker SRL

> Insurance ING Broker SRL is a licensed insurance and reinsurance brokerage in the Republic of Moldova, regulated by CNPF and affiliated with the RENOMIA International network. Founded in 2004, ISO-certified, the only such broker in Moldova.

- International Network: RENOMIA International (Czech Republic, 30+ countries)
- Certification: ISO Certified (only ISO-certified broker in Moldova)
- Languages: Romanian, Russian, English

## Retail Insurance (B2C) via easigurari.com
- RCA (Mandatory Motor Third Party Liability)
- Carte Verde (Green Card International Motor Insurance)
- CASCO (Comprehensive Motor Insurance)
- Travel Medical Insurance
- Property Insurance (Home, Office, Buildings)

## Corporate Insurance (B2B) via ingbroker.md

- Product Liability Insurance
